    Dear Ctrip Review Team:

    We formally appeal the 1-star review left by guest Li for order #88921 (Room 304). The review contains statements about our facilities and service that do not match the facts.

    Point 1: "Room not clean"
    Evidence: Attached housekeeping inspection log and timestamped supervisor verification photos showing Room 304 was cleaned and inspected to standard at 14:45 on check-in day.

    Point 2: "AC not working / blowing hot air"
    Evidence: Export from our central IoT climate system. Data shows the AC in Room 304 operated normally and maintained 22°C throughout the stay.

    Given objective system evidence contradicts the guest's claims, we request removal of this review under your policy on factually inaccurate feedback.

    Thank you for your prompt handling.
